description: This file defines an abstract activity class 'LockedActivity' for the Android Notes application, handling device lock/unlock procedures, security flags, and interaction updates.

classes.name: LockedActivity
classes.description: An abstract activity providing lock-screen functionality and interaction tracking for the Notes app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets exception handler, enforces security flags, and prompts device unlock if needed.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Checks if the activity is not the root task and prompts for unlock accordingly.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Updates last interaction timestamp if activity is the root task.

methods.name: onBackPressed
methods.description: Handles back press event and updates last interaction timestamp.

methods.name: startActivityForResult
methods.description: Overrides to update last interaction before starting new activities.

methods.name: startActivity
methods.description: Overrides to update last interaction before starting a new activity.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from unlock activity, unlocking app or finishing activity based on success.

methods.name: askToUnlock
methods.description: Prompts the user to unlock the device using device credentials if locked.
